faq.intro: Find answers to frequently asked questions about our services, process, and how we build AI-first high-performance websites.

items.question: What services does AchiDigital offer?
items.answer: We offer AI-first website development, full-stack web applications, UI/UX design, SEO and LLM search optimization, content strategy, performance engineering, and AI automation solutions tailored to your business goals.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: Project timelines depend on scope and complexity. A professional business website typically takes 4–6 weeks, while advanced web applications or AI-powered platforms may take 8–16 weeks.

items.question: What is your pricing structure?
items.answer: We provide transparent pricing tailored to your project requirements. Depending on the engagement, we offer fixed-scope pricing, milestone-based contracts, or long-term strategic partnerships.

items.question: Do you provide ongoing support and optimization?
items.answer: Yes. We offer ongoing support, technical maintenance, security updates, SEO monitoring, performance optimization, and continuous AI improvements to ensure long-term growth.

items.question: Can you work with existing platforms or systems?
items.answer: Absolutely. We integrate with existing CMS platforms, APIs, CRMs, ERPs, e-commerce systems, and third-party tools to enhance your current infrastructure without disruption.

items.question: What makes AchiDigital different?
items.answer: We are an AI-first growth-focused agency. We combine engineering precision, performance optimization, multilingual SEO, and conversion strategy to build websites that generate measurable business results.
